jobs.title: Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer
jobs.desc: div class= content-intro p Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. /p /div p strong The Team /strong /p p Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. /p p strong The Role /strong /p p As a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. /p p This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. strong You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact. /strong /p p strong The Work You’ll Do /strong /p p strong Initiate and Connect /strong /p ul li Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases /li li Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria /li li Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required /li /ul p strong Build amp; Industry Depth /strong /p ul li Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals /li li Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage /li li Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap /li /ul p strong What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era /strong /p ul li You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually /li li You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly /li li You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers /li li You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer /li li You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable /li /ul p strong The Qualifications You Need /strong /p ul li strong Experience: /strong 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. /li li strong Platform skills: nbsp; /strong Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
jobs.desc: Staff Backend Engineer – Platform Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. What you'll be up to Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. Some of the challenges waiting for you Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll bring to the team 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. Where you'll work from This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
